notes: The to of preached the gospel to that city stays inside the verb's unit: πόλιν is accusative and has no case for an English preposition to realize, so rule 106's accusative arm and rule 21's frame clause both keep it with the frame.

Εὐαγγελισάμενοι heads on gospel and μαθητεύσαντες on disciples, both denominal verbs whose English noun glosses the lexeme while preached and made are the verbalizing support words; the ASV's gloss note here records brought the good tidings and corroborates it.
Both variants at this verse are selected units whose base readings the ASV translates, so no rule 97 note is owed.
